title: gingidium decipiens
intro: Gingidium decipiens, commonly known as the "Sarangia" or "Yellow Orchid", is a flowering plant native to tropical Asia. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Gingidium decipiens include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Gingidium decipiens have been identified to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
